exposure: birth weight less than one kilogram
cohort: 77 preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit who had failed extubation between January 2014 and December 2020
finding: Male gender, birth weight less than one kilogram, gestational age <28 weeks, sedation, caffeine administration, previous history of extubation failure, lower hemoglobin levels, and a lower APGAR score at 5 min were significantly associated with extubation failure.
gest_age: Mean gestational age: Not reported, but 45.5% of the patients had a gestational age <28 weeks
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: Not reported, but 37.7% had a birth weight <1 kg
